name: composition-yields
of: A mechanism by which composing two or more passes (a fresh-context critic, a seriator, a blind judge, a rotated register, an adversarial trial, an embedding neighbour, a second model family, a repairer who may only cut) produces a member, an ordering, or a distinction no single pass yields, named with the composition's shape, what crosses between the passes (nothing, a name, a number, a verdict word, a slip, an artifact, a transcript, the other hand's rejections), where the judgment ends up sitting (in a rule written before any case, in a seat that cannot fail, in a reader of the other hand's work, or nowhere), and the degradation (agreement for a shared reason, de-blinding by voice, averaging the shape away, the cell's name plus a case, a verdict attractor, a report that becomes the next attractor, a rewrite slot in a cut-only hand, a silent fix, a fence pre-drawn by the author's residue), and sorted by what crosses between the passes, from nothing to the other hand's reasoning.
items: Swap and compare: the same adjudication is run twice with the seats' occupants exchanged, and the two verdicts meet at a rule that can say only whether they agree, so the composition yields a distinction no single run holds, a verdict that belongs to the idea against one that belongs to the seat, as the atlas's trial that reruns with the advocate's and adversary's models swapped and returns contested when the verdict flips, the crossover trial that gives each patient both treatments in both orders so that the order effect is separated from the drug, the counterbalanced experiment and the Latin square, the referee pair reversed for the second leg; the composition's shape is a pass and its mirror image; what crosses between the runs is nothing, since the second run must not know the first's verdict, and the only meeting is at the comparator; the judgment sits in the comparator's rule, which cannot say which run was right, only that the pair is unstable, so the yield is a label on the pair and the unstable case is handed on as residue rather than resolved; the degradation is agreement for a shared reason, since two occupants who carry the same prior give the same verdict in either seat and the rule reads that as stability of the idea when it is symmetry of the prior, the two laboratories that replicate each other with the same reagent lot; the tell that separates the two is a swap that never flips on any claim, which measures the occupants' sameness and not the ideas' soundness; observed in the trial's design and in crossover trials, and the atlas's corpus holds no trial transcript, so the repo case is a rule and not yet a result; not denominator-manufactures' second net, which counts what the two nets missed, since here nothing is counted and the yield is a stability label on one verdict.

Judges who cannot see each other: each of two or more judges reads the same question on the same named axis without seeing the others' reads, and the composition yields the spread, which no single judge can produce because one read has no spread, and the spread localizes where the question underdetermines its answer, as the atlas's triangulation that refuses to run with one judge and names any axis where the reads split in sign as contested residue for an owner, the first round of a Delphi panel before the estimates are fed back, the two radiologists who read the film before conferring, the census count and the post-enumeration survey kept from each other's rosters; the composition's shape is parallel reads joined only at a table; what crosses is the axis wording, from whoever dimensionalized the question to every judge, and nothing between the judges; the judgment sits nowhere, since the composition's output on a contested axis is a name and an owner rather than a verdict, and only on an uncontested axis does it compress to a number; the degradation is consensus collapse, which arrives the moment a judge can see another's read, the Delphi second round that converges on the median, the jury room, the reviewer who reads the other reviews first, so that the spread narrows without the question changing; the tell is a spread that shrinks with the order in which the reads were taken; a second degradation is that the axes were one judge's, since the first judge dimensionalizes when no axes are given, so the panel disagrees only inside one judge's frame and an axis nobody named is contested by nobody; observed in the triangulation's design and in Delphi panels; not Combiner's arithmetic, which holds what the table does to the reads once they are in, since here the mechanism is the wall between the judges.

Second family's difference: the same enumeration is run by two enumerators with different priors, and the composition yields the difference of their lists, which is a distinction about the members, that a member is reachable from one prior and not the other, rather than a bigger pile, as two field guides to the same coast whose birds each lacks, two dictionaries' headword lists, the atlas's refusal to accept two identical judge commands as a panel, since identical judges are one judge; the composition's shape is two passes over one question joined at a set difference; what crosses is the question and nothing else; the judgment sits in the reader of the difference, who must decide whether an item only one family reached is the family's artifact or the subject's member that the other family cannot see; the degradation is the vote, which keeps the intersection and discards the difference, so a majority over families returns the members every prior already held and throws away the only thing the composition made, and the second degradation is families that share a corpus, whose difference is empty for a reason the composition cannot see; the tell of a spent composition is a difference that shrinks as the families are made more capable, since capable families converge on the modal members; analytical, since the atlas's climb ledgers name the hand that made each breath and fifty-five of eighty-two lists were bred by more than one hand, so the difference set is computable and has not been computed; adds to denominator-manufactures' second net, which uses the two nets' overlap to estimate what both missed, the reading of the non-overlap as a member class; not Blind judge, which rates the passes, since here no one rates and the difference is the yield.

Register rotation diff: the same hand enumerates the same subject once under each register on a roster and the lists are laid side by side, so the composition yields a survival profile per item, which registers keep it and which drop it, and from the profiles an ordering of the list from the members every register reaches to the items only one register can say, which register-yields can rule for one item under one register and this composition reads for the whole list at once, as the atlas's register roster, whose forty-eight registers each assert an unlock and whose rotation over one list has not been run, the field guide's species list beside the statute's protected list for the same coast, the same case argued in the legal and the clinical register; the composition's shape is one hand sent round a ring of registers and a table that counts survivals; what crosses is the subject's name and the item type, and never a previous list; the judgment sits in the roster, chosen before any list was written, since an item's profile is only as wide as the registers on the ring, and a reader rules only at the ends of the ordering, where an item kept by one register is either that register's artifact or a member the others cannot reach; the degradation is the translation, since a rotator shown a previous list writes it again in the new voice, every item survives, and the flat profile reads as all subject and no artifact; the tell is a second list with the same count in the same order; analytical, since the roster exists and the rotation over any list has not been run; not Second family's difference, which moves the hand and holds the register and so reads its diff as a fact about priors, since here the hand is held and the register moved, so a lost item can be re-asked of the same hand in the first register to separate the register's artifact from the hand's own variance, which a difference between two hands cannot do; adds to register-yields' tell, that an item which cannot be restated flat was the register's, the operational form of that tell, a ring of registers instead of the flat one and the whole list at once.

Blind judge: candidates from two or more passes are pooled and stripped of their source before a judge rates them, so the composition yields a rating of the passes, which no pass can give itself and which a judge who knew the source would give to the source, as the orchestra audition behind a screen, the 1976 Paris tasting in which French judges ranked Californian wines first, blind peer review, the parsimony climb that accepts a deletion only if it survives a defence made without knowing who proposed the cut; the composition's shape is a fan-in with the labels removed; what crosses is the candidates without their provenance, and the provenance is held back by a third hand who re-attaches it after the rating; the judgment sits in the judge, but the yield is read by the hand that holds the labels; the degradation is de-blinding by voice, since each pass writes in a register and the judge reads the register as the source, the screen that does not hide the sound of heels, the reviewer who recognizes the laboratory from the methods section, so that the rating of the passes becomes a rating of registers; the tell is a rating that reproduces the source labels better than chance when the labels are checked; observed outside in auditions and the tasting, analytical in the atlas, whose records carry the hand that made them in the made_by field that the critic seat reads, so the seat is not blind and the map's rating of its own passes has not been made; adds to witness-architectures' instrument that must be built not to see, the case where what it must not see is the hand that made the candidate.

Combiner's arithmetic: several reads cross as numbers to a table whose rule decides what a disagreement becomes, and the composition yields either a verdict no reader gave or the disagreement as a member, according to the rule and not the reads, as the ensemble forecast whose mean track runs between two storm tracks through water no member predicted, the trimmed mean of the diving panel, the atlas's trial that returns contested on a sign split and refuses to average, its triangulation that reports the spread beside the mean; the composition's shape is a fan-in through arithmetic; what crosses is a number per read, since the reasons are stripped at the table; the judgment sits in the rule, which was written before any read was taken, so the map's most consequential seat is one that had no case in front of it; the degradation is averaging the shape away, a mean of plus and minus that reads as balance, and its mirror, a contested threshold so wide that every panel is contested and the composition never compresses; the tell of the first is a verdict at the middle of the scale that no read occupied, and of the second an owner list as long as the axis list; observed in ensemble forecasting and in the trial's rule; not Judges who cannot see each other, which holds the wall that makes the reads independent, since the table's rule does its work on reads however they were made.

Embedding neighbour pair: a pass that measures nearness in an embedding hands a reader a pair of items and a number, and the composition yields the pairs a reader would never have compared, since a reader compares neighbours in list order and a list of eighty-five has three thousand five hundred and seventy pairs, so the wrong-grain tell in item-grains, the eighty-five that is twelve with synonyms, becomes readable at scale, as the plagiarism report that shows two passages side by side with a percentage, the patent search that returns the nearest claims, the near-duplicate pass over a corpus before the editors read it; the composition's shape is a filter that proposes pairs and a reader who rules on them; what crosses is a pair and a number; the judgment sits in the reader, but the reader's queue was set by the number; the degradation is anchoring by the number, since two items near in embedding share a domain and a vocabulary and may differ in mechanism, and a reader shown a pair labelled near merges what a cold read would have kept, while two rephrasings that use disjoint vocabulary never reach the reader at all; the tell is a merge whose surviving text has to be lengthened to hold both mechanisms; analytical, since the atlas embeds every list for ordering and the same vectors would serve this filter, and it has not been run; adds to item-grains' wrong-grain tell the composition that can read it over more pairs than a reader can hold.

Gap named by one hand: one pass induces a typology over the list and names the cells that are empty or thin, a second pass fills the named cell, and nothing crosses between them but the cell's name, so the composition yields members in a region the flat pass would not reach and the yield's quality is set by what the name carries, as the atlas's climb, whose strong tier names up to three missing types and whose cheap tier is shown the list and the type name and asked for six members, and against it Mendeleev's eka-silicon, whose empty cell crossed to Winkler not as a name but as a predicted atomic weight, density, and oxide, so that the filler could recognize germanium when it was in the crucible; the composition's shape is a namer and a filler in series; what crosses is a name, or in the strong form a name with predicted properties; the judgment sits in the namer, since the filler answers the name, and the gate that judges the fill judges it against the list and not against the typology, which never crosses to the gate at all; the degradation is the cell's name plus a case, the item that reads as the type's label applied to the nearest example, which form-yields names as the manufactured item's tell; the tell here is a fill whose members all contain the type name; observed in the climb's design and in the periodic table; adds to form-yields' empty cell, which holds what the form makes visible, the fact that in a composition the cell's name is the only thing the filler sees, so the yield rises with what the namer was made to predict and not with the filler's tier.

Measure then name: an engine orders a list by measured similarity and a second pass names the axis the order runs along and votes on whether the axis is revelatory, so the composition yields an order nobody authored and a claim nobody measured, as the atlas's seriation, whose engine picks the smoother of a spectral and a greedy order, whose strong-tier namer may reverse the direction and marks its own name revelatory or clustering, and factor analysis, whose rotation is computed and whose factor is named by the psychologist, so that neuroticism and the general factor carry the computation's authority on a name the computation never produced; the composition's shape is a measurer and a namer in series; what crosses is the ordered items without the numbers, and a name crosses back; the judgment sits in the namer, who cannot fail, since every order gets a name, and whose revelatory flag is the namer's vote on the namer's own name; the degradation is a name over local clustering, a story told about an order that is three clusters in a row; the tell is a name that cannot be falsified from the order it names, and the changed move is to have the namer place a held-out item before seeing where the engine put it; a second observed shape is precedence, since the atlas's driver skips any list whose record already carries a seriation, so a fieldwork map's authored walk pre-empts the measured order for good and the only trace of which hand ordered it is the method field, model-direct against spectral; observed; adds to form-yields' named axis, which holds what an axis makes visible, the split of the axis into a measured half and a named half with no seat that holds both.

Verdict menu: a critic seat is given a menu of verdicts and an asymmetric cost for each, so the composition yields the modal verdict whatever the input, and the distribution of verdicts is a fact about the seat and not about the maps, as the atlas's thirty-eight critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs and never admit, return-for-another-breath, or reject, the reviewer's minor revisions, the audit that finds three findings because an audit with none is suspected of not having looked, the grade that compresses toward B-plus; the composition's shape is an author, a critic with a menu, and a repairer who applies the verdict; what crosses into the seat is the record, the ledger, and the menu, and what crosses out is one word from the menu and a list of repairs; the judgment sits in the menu's costs, since a verdict that kills the map costs the seat a defence, a verdict that admits it unrepaired costs the seat its evidence of having read, and the middle option costs nothing; the degradation is the verdict attractor, a distribution with no variance over inputs of different quality; the tell is that variance, readable only across many maps and by whoever holds the fleet's ledger and never by the seat, whose every verdict was locally reasonable; observed, with the same shape inside the verdict, since the thirty-eight critiques made two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, and three cuts, so the repair decision is the item-level middle option as admit-with-repairs is the map-level one; not the critic's judgment on any item, which may each be right, since the mechanism is in the menu.

Telling the seat its attractor: a distribution produced by a composition's own seat is reported back to the seat as an instruction before the next run, and the composition yields a shifted distribution set by the instruction, which is still not set by the maps, as this fleet's critic brief, which names the thirty-eight admit-with-repairs to the seat and calls an admit with zero repairs a finding, the grade-inflation memo that produces a year of deflation, the audit team told that every prior audit found three findings; the composition's shape is a seat, a ledger that counts its verdicts, and a hand that writes the count into the next brief; what crosses is the prior distribution, condensed to one sentence, as an instruction; the judgment sits in the instruction's author, since the seat now proves it can return each verdict; the degradation is the second attractor, a distribution that tracks the last report rather than the maps, so a fleet with a distribution correction reads well against the previous fleet and not against its inputs; the tell is a verdict distribution that shifts in the direction of the instruction across maps of the same quality, and it is readable only from a third fleet whose brief carries no report; speculative, and as of the independent critic's read on 2026-09-13 six of this fleet's seven critiques had returned with the report in their brief and all six were admit-with-repairs, so the report alone had not moved the seat and the shift remains a prediction, with the second possibility now live, that a seat told its attractor names the report and returns the modal verdict anyway; not Verdict menu, which holds the attractor the menu sets, since here the attractor is set by the report of the last attractor, and the loop between them is the map's.

Earliest slip: many narrow readers each send a slip with a quotation and a date to one editor, and the composition yields an ordering, the earliest attestation, that no reader could produce because each reader has one book, as the Oxford English Dictionary's reading programme, whose volunteers' slips gave each sense its first date, and the antedatings that arrived once newspaper archives were searchable, which showed how many first dates had been first-in-the-canon; the composition's shape is a fan-in of narrow passes to one combiner who sorts; what crosses is the slip, a case with a date and nothing of the reader's judgment; the judgment sits in the editor who sorts and defines, and the readers hold none of it; the degradation is the readers' corpus, since the earliest slip is the earliest in what the readers read, and the ordering inherits the canon's bias without any reader having chosen it; the tell is an antedating that arrives from a corpus of a new kind rather than from another reader of the old kind; observed; adds to denominator-manufactures' accumulation curve, which flattens as readers of one corpus saturate, the fact that the ordering yield saturates before the member count does, since a later reader of the same books can add a sense and not an earlier date; not Cheap proposer, strong gate, where the gate refuses, since the editor here refuses nothing and sorts.

Cheap proposer, strong gate: a cheap pass proposes many candidates and a strong pass judges each against the list, so the composition yields volume the strong pass would not spend on and a recorded refusal for every drop, which is a labelled nonmember no single pass produces, as the atlas's climb whose cheap tier offers fifteen and whose strong-tier gate keeps or drops each with a reason written to the ledger, the patent examiner who can reject only the claims the applicant drafted, the acquisitions desk over the slush pile, the journal whose quality is bounded by what is submitted; the composition's shape is a proposer and a gate that can only subtract; what crosses is the candidates as text and the list to both sides; the judgment sits in the gate, but the frontier of the list sits in the proposer, since the gate cannot add, so a strong gate spends its taste sorting a cheap prior's rephrasings and the list's edge is the proposer's edge; the degradation is the plateau read as exhaustion, since a falling keep rate measures the proposer's frontier meeting the list and the flag cannot say whether the subject ran out or the proposer did, which enumeration-stalls holds; the second degradation is refusal without memory, since the gate is shown the list and never the ledger's residue, so a candidate refused last breath can be proposed and refused again as new; the tell of a spent proposer is a keep rate that tracks the proposer's tier and not the subject; observed; adds to enumeration-stalls' plateau the fact that the stall in this composition is the proposer's and the gate is the wrong seat to read it from.

Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot: the last hand in the composition may only apply the critic's cuts and repairs, or refuse one with a reason written to the ledger, and may add nothing, so the composition yields provenance, every surviving item is the author's and the critic's taste enters only as subtraction, and the map cannot drift toward the critic's mode; but the repair carries a slot for full replacement text, so the cut-only rule is porous and a repaired item is a member the critic authored under the author's name, as the atlas's repairer, forbidden to add items of its own, told to apply every repair and cut the critic justified, and allowed to preserve an item against the critic only as residue with a why, the copy editor who may only cut and rewrites in the margin, the appellate court that may only affirm, reverse, or remand and writes the opinion the trial court must follow; the composition's shape is author, critic, repairer in series with a one-way valve at the end, whose one voice is the refusal; what crosses is a critique with a decision per item and a replacement text for each repair; the judgment sits in the critic, but the authorship of the final text sits in whoever filled the slot; the degradation is the leak, since a repair that changes the cases or the mechanism is an addition the rule forbade, and the ledger then counts it as kept, so the keep rate reads one while the text is another hand's; the tell is a repaired item whose cases changed, and across the thirty-eight critiques the seat made two hundred and eight repairs and three cuts, so the slot, not the valve, is where the critic's hand entered the atlas; observed; adds to environment-loops' keep rate of one by construction the mechanism inside the construction, the slot through which the count stays one while the text changes.

Cascade from the first pass: a change made by one pass is read by a later pass that reports every consequence as its own finding, so the composition yields a count of dependents, which edges rested on the changed item, that neither pass could list alone, and the same channel manufactures spurious failures, as the compiler that reports forty type errors from one missing bracket, the atlas's checker that compares relation endpoints to items by exact string and reports every edge whose endpoint was repaired, the repair brief that warns the repairer to update every place the old string appears; the composition's shape is a writer and a checker in series with identity carried by text; what crosses is the whole record, and the item's text is its identity, so a repair is a new item and every edge to it is an edge to nothing; the judgment sits in the checker, which reports all violations at once so the repairer can fix in one pass, and which cannot tell a broken edge from an edge whose label no longer argues what its new endpoint says; the degradation is the silent fix, the search-and-replace that satisfies the checker while the label still claims what it claimed about the old text, so the cascade is cleared and the edge is now a false claim that passes; the tell is a label unchanged over an endpoint that changed, and the changed move is to re-author every label the cascade named rather than to re-point it; observed; adds to form-yields' graph the fact that in a composition the graph's edges are held by string identity, so the form's yield after a repair is the list of edges the repair invalidated, which is a distinction no author of the edges had when writing them.

Sovereign charters at maximin: each party to a negotiation scores only its own declared constraints, proposal rights rotate, and at impasse the surviving proposal is the one whose worst satisfaction is highest, so the composition yields a proposal in the joint feasible region that no party would have proposed and, at impasse, the binding constraints, the pair that cannot both hold, which no party can name alone because each sees only its own charter, as the atlas's parley, the treaty that must pass every parliament and whose sticking clause is found only when the third parliament refuses, the class settlement whose holdout names the term nobody else had priced; the composition's shape is a ring of proposers and a rule at the end; what crosses is each proposal and each party's score of its own charter, and the charters themselves never cross; the judgment sits distributed, since no party grades another's constraints, and the impasse's yield is a named conflict handed to the residue rather than a settlement; the degradation is the hardened soft constraint, since a party that declares a preference as a hard constraint captures the maximin, and the rule cannot tell a real floor from a declared one; the tell is a binding constraint that the same party later trades away; analytical, since the parley's rule is observed in the atlas and no recorded accord or impasse is in its corpus; not Judges who cannot see each other, where the reads are of one question, since here each party reads a different charter and the yield is the conflict between charters.

Trial with a burden: an advocate and an adversary build opposing cases under one scaffold and a judge reads the transcript under a burden set by the claim's class, so the composition yields grounds, the argument that decided it, which a judge reading the bare claim cannot name because without an opposing case nothing decided anything, as the atlas's trial whose judge must answer with a lean and one sentence naming the deciding argument, the moot court, the adversarial hearing whose finding of fact cites the cross-examination; the composition's shape is two opposed passes and a reader; what crosses is the opposing case to each side, and the whole transcript to the judge; the judgment sits in the judge, with the burden's threshold set by a hand that never saw the case, and an unproven claim is rejected rather than split; the degradation is the last word, since a balanced scaffold still has an order, and in the atlas's cross-examination the adversary answers last in every round, while the courtroom gives the last word to the side that carries the burden, so the two designs balance opposite asymmetries and neither is symmetric; the second degradation is eloquence, which the judge is told to disregard and which the transcript carries anyway; the tell is a verdict that moves when the order of the closing turns is reversed with the arguments held fixed; observed in the trial's design and the courtroom's, with no atlas transcript on record; not Swap and compare, which exchanges the occupants, since here the seats keep their occupants and the mechanism is the order of the seats.

Residue crossing to the fresh critic: the critic seat is denied the author's reasoning and given the record and the ledger, and the ledger carries the author's residue, the candidates the author rejected with why, so what was meant to be a fresh read of the fence arrives with the author's fence already drawn, and the composition yields, per map, a fact about the critic's boundary case, whether it is the author's residue re-read or a fence the author never tested, as the atlas's critique briefs that forbid the author's reasoning and require the ledger, and the eleven of thirty-eight critiques whose boundary case names one of the author's residue items, the reviewer sent the authors' response to an earlier round, the second radiologist handed the first's negative findings; the composition's shape is author then critic with a partial wall; what crosses is the artifact and, through the ledger, the author's rejections; the judgment sits in the critic on the items and in the author on the fence, whenever the fence crossed; the degradation is the re-read, a boundary case that is the author's tempting nonmember returned with the author's ruling, so the composition's independence was spent everywhere except where the practice's sharpening check wanted it; the tell is readable from the two files without reading either map, a residue handle inside the critique's boundary case; observed at eleven of thirty-eight by a string match on the residue handle, so the true rate is at least that; adds to fertile-forgettings' loss that creates a capacity the case where the loss was declared and did not occur, and to window-successions' ledger the fact that the ledger was built for the successor breath and is read by the critic as well.

source.register: Written for someone who makes lists and runs reasoners for a living, operator-grade and concrete: swapped seats and crossover trials, walls between judges and Delphi rounds, set differences over field guides, screens at auditions and the Paris tasting, ensemble mean tracks, near-duplicate pairs with a percentage, empty cells with predicted properties, computed orders with authored names, verdict menus and minor revisions, a report written into the next brief, reading-programme slips and antedatings, slush piles and patent examiners, rewrite slots and appellate opinions, compilers' error cascades and exact-string checkers, closing-argument order, sovereign charters at maximin, and a ledger's residue read by the critic; drawn from the atlas's own trial, triangulation, parley, seriation, climb, checker, critic, and repair briefs, named by seat and tier, and from clinical trials, forecasting, lexicography, patent examination, peer review, orchestral hiring, adversarial procedure, and treaty ratification.
mode: Analytical distinctions with observed cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Observed: Swap and compare, Judges who cannot see each other, Combiner's arithmetic, Trial with a burden, Gap named by one hand, Measure then name, Cheap proposer, strong gate, Verdict menu, Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot, Cascade from the first pass, and Residue crossing to the fresh critic are read from the atlas's code, briefs, ledgers, and critiques, with the counts named in the limits, and from documented outside practice; where the atlas case is a design with no run on record (the trial, the triangulation, the parley), the item says so. Analytical: Second family's difference, Register rotation diff, Embedding neighbour pair, and Sovereign charters at maximin name a pass the atlas has and a composition it has not run. Blind judge is observed outside (the Paris tasting, screened auditions) and analytical in the atlas, whose critic seat reads the made_by field. Speculative: Telling the seat its attractor predicts a shift in this fleet's verdict distribution that has not been counted. No item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy; a real pipeline runs several of these compositions at once, often one inside another, and the list makes no claim to cover every shape.

The seriation is an itinerary of what crosses between the passes, not a ranking of value or reliability; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the loop, the two incompatibilities, the dependency, and the passage they draw are interpretations.

The atlas cases are read from the passes' code and from ledger and critique counts computed by script on 2026-09-13 (thirty-eight critiques, two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, three cuts, eleven boundary cases matching a residue handle, fifty-five of eighty-two ledgers with more than one hand); they are counts of files by string match, not a human read of each, and the residue match is a floor. The trial, the parley, and the triangulation are designs with no transcript in the corpus, and their items say so.

Outside cases (crossover trials, Delphi panels, the Paris tasting, blind auditions, ensemble forecasting, the reading programme and its antedatings, Mendeleev's eka-silicon, compilers' error lists, closing-argument order) are simplified to one mechanism each; Telling the seat its attractor is speculative and predicts a shift this fleet has not yet shown.

The doctrine of splitting generator from critic is the catalog's own and is not an item. Neighbouring maps: form-yields holds what a form does to a pile and the cell's-name-plus-a-case tell, where Gap named by one hand holds the crossing that makes the filler see only the name; denominator-manufactures holds the second net and the shuffle as universes, where Second family's difference reads the non-overlap as a member class; register-yields holds what one register does to a list, where Register rotation diff reads two; enumeration-stalls holds the stall, where Cheap proposer, strong gate holds the seat that cannot read it; environment-loops holds the loop back to the same reasoner and the keep rate of one by construction, where Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot holds the slot inside the construction; window-successions holds what a carrier strips, where this map holds only how thick the carrier is.

seriation.axis: What crosses between the passes, walked from nothing to the other hand's reasoning: nothing but a meeting at a comparator, an axis wording from above, the bare question, the subject's name and item type, candidates with their source held back, a number per read, a pair and a number, a cell's name, an order out and a name back, a menu in and a word out, a distribution condensed to a sentence, a slip, candidates and the list, a critique with replacement text, the whole record, proposals and scores with the charters withheld, the opposing case and the transcript, and the author's own rejections.
seriation.note: An authored walk of what crosses, not a ranking of value. Swap and compare opens it because nothing crosses between its runs and its judgment is a rule that cannot say which run was right; Residue crossing to the fresh critic closes it because the author's rejections cross and the judgment on the fence returns to the author. The walk carries two things the bare list did not. On the thin half the degradation is made of what did not cross: a shared prior the comparator cannot see, a corpus two families share, a voice that leaks the source; on the thick half it is made of what did: a name answered as a label plus a case, a report that becomes the next attractor, a replacement text under another's name, a residue that pre-draws the fence. And the seat of judgment moves along it: at the thin end it sits in a rule written before any case, a comparator, a wall, a diff, an arithmetic; in the middle in a seat that cannot fail, a namer or a menu; at the thick end in a reader of the other hand's work. The hinge is Gap named by one hand, the first crossing thick enough to anchor, where the yield rises with what the name was made to predict. Sovereign charters at maximin sits thinner than Trial with a burden because the charters are withheld and the transcript is not. The walk sorts each item by the crossing its yield turns on, not by everything that enters its seat: Verdict menu takes in the record, the ledger, and the menu, but sits at the menu, since the menu sets its attractor; Residue crossing to the fresh critic takes in the same record and ledger and sits at the rejections. Four items, Verdict menu, Telling the seat its attractor, Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot, and Residue crossing to the fresh critic, are one pipeline whose several crossings the walk splits by that key (placement key stated at the independent critic's finding, 2026-09-13).

relations.from: Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot: the last hand in the composition may only apply the critic's cuts and repairs, or refuse one with a reason written to the ledger, and may add nothing, so the composition yields provenance, every surviving item is the author's and the critic's taste enters only as subtraction, and the map cannot drift toward the critic's mode; but the repair carries a slot for full replacement text, so the cut-only rule is porous and a repaired item is a member the critic authored under the author's name, as the atlas's repairer, forbidden to add items of its own, told to apply every repair and cut the critic justified, and allowed to preserve an item against the critic only as residue with a why, the copy editor who may only cut and rewrites in the margin, the appellate court that may only affirm, reverse, or remand and writes the opinion the trial court must follow; the composition's shape is author, critic, repairer in series with a one-way valve at the end, whose one voice is the refusal; what crosses is a critique with a decision per item and a replacement text for each repair; the judgment sits in the critic, but the authorship of the final text sits in whoever filled the slot; the degradation is the leak, since a repair that changes the cases or the mechanism is an addition the rule forbade, and the ledger then counts it as kept, so the keep rate reads one while the text is another hand's; the tell is a repaired item whose cases changed, and across the thirty-eight critiques the seat made two hundred and eight repairs and three cuts, so the slot, not the valve, is where the critic's hand entered the atlas; observed; adds to environment-loops' keep rate of one by construction the mechanism inside the construction, the slot through which the count stays one while the text changes.
relations.to: Cascade from the first pass: a change made by one pass is read by a later pass that reports every consequence as its own finding, so the composition yields a count of dependents, which edges rested on the changed item, that neither pass could list alone, and the same channel manufactures spurious failures, as the compiler that reports forty type errors from one missing bracket, the atlas's checker that compares relation endpoints to items by exact string and reports every edge whose endpoint was repaired, the repair brief that warns the repairer to update every place the old string appears; the composition's shape is a writer and a checker in series with identity carried by text; what crosses is the whole record, and the item's text is its identity, so a repair is a new item and every edge to it is an edge to nothing; the judgment sits in the checker, which reports all violations at once so the repairer can fix in one pass, and which cannot tell a broken edge from an edge whose label no longer argues what its new endpoint says; the degradation is the silent fix, the search-and-replace that satisfies the checker while the label still claims what it claimed about the old text, so the cascade is cleared and the edge is now a false claim that passes; the tell is a label unchanged over an endpoint that changed, and the changed move is to re-author every label the cascade named rather than to re-point it; observed; adds to form-yields' graph the fact that in a composition the graph's edges are held by string identity, so the form's yield after a repair is the list of edges the repair invalidated, which is a distinction no author of the edges had when writing them.
relations.label: If a repair changes an item's text, every edge whose endpoint was that text fails the checker, so the cascade's count is the repair's dependents and not the map's faults; where the repairer re-points the endpoints without re-authoring the labels, the cascade clears and each label now claims of the new text what it argued of the old, so a repair that entered through the rewrite slot exits as a set of edges nobody argued; a cut cascades too, since every edge to the cut item fails, but its cascade cannot be silently fixed, because a cut edge has no new endpoint to lie about and must be deleted, and where the deletions take the map under the checker's floor of four the cut-only hand must author an edge, an addition the rule forbade arriving through the checker rather than the slot.

relations.from: Verdict menu: a critic seat is given a menu of verdicts and an asymmetric cost for each, so the composition yields the modal verdict whatever the input, and the distribution of verdicts is a fact about the seat and not about the maps, as the atlas's thirty-eight critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs and never admit, return-for-another-breath, or reject, the reviewer's minor revisions, the audit that finds three findings because an audit with none is suspected of not having looked, the grade that compresses toward B-plus; the composition's shape is an author, a critic with a menu, and a repairer who applies the verdict; what crosses into the seat is the record, the ledger, and the menu, and what crosses out is one word from the menu and a list of repairs; the judgment sits in the menu's costs, since a verdict that kills the map costs the seat a defence, a verdict that admits it unrepaired costs the seat its evidence of having read, and the middle option costs nothing; the degradation is the verdict attractor, a distribution with no variance over inputs of different quality; the tell is that variance, readable only across many maps and by whoever holds the fleet's ledger and never by the seat, whose every verdict was locally reasonable; observed, with the same shape inside the verdict, since the thirty-eight critiques made two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, and three cuts, so the repair decision is the item-level middle option as admit-with-repairs is the map-level one; not the critic's judgment on any item, which may each be right, since the mechanism is in the menu.
relations.to: Telling the seat its attractor: a distribution produced by a composition's own seat is reported back to the seat as an instruction before the next run, and the composition yields a shifted distribution set by the instruction, which is still not set by the maps, as this fleet's critic brief, which names the thirty-eight admit-with-repairs to the seat and calls an admit with zero repairs a finding, the grade-inflation memo that produces a year of deflation, the audit team told that every prior audit found three findings; the composition's shape is a seat, a ledger that counts its verdicts, and a hand that writes the count into the next brief; what crosses is the prior distribution, condensed to one sentence, as an instruction; the judgment sits in the instruction's author, since the seat now proves it can return each verdict; the degradation is the second attractor, a distribution that tracks the last report rather than the maps, so a fleet with a distribution correction reads well against the previous fleet and not against its inputs; the tell is a verdict distribution that shifts in the direction of the instruction across maps of the same quality, and it is readable only from a third fleet whose brief carries no report; speculative, and as of the independent critic's read on 2026-09-13 six of this fleet's seven critiques had returned with the report in their brief and all six were admit-with-repairs, so the report alone had not moved the seat and the shift remains a prediction, with the second possibility now live, that a seat told its attractor names the report and returns the modal verdict anyway; not Verdict menu, which holds the attractor the menu sets, since here the attractor is set by the report of the last attractor, and the loop between them is the map's.
relations.label: If the menu's distribution is counted and the count is written into the next seat's brief, the attractor moves from the menu to the report, and the next distribution reads well against the last fleet whatever the maps did; where the count is held by the ledger and never reported, the menu's attractor stands and is at least stable.

relations.from: Swap and compare: the same adjudication is run twice with the seats' occupants exchanged, and the two verdicts meet at a rule that can say only whether they agree, so the composition yields a distinction no single run holds, a verdict that belongs to the idea against one that belongs to the seat, as the atlas's trial that reruns with the advocate's and adversary's models swapped and returns contested when the verdict flips, the crossover trial that gives each patient both treatments in both orders so that the order effect is separated from the drug, the counterbalanced experiment and the Latin square, the referee pair reversed for the second leg; the composition's shape is a pass and its mirror image; what crosses between the runs is nothing, since the second run must not know the first's verdict, and the only meeting is at the comparator; the judgment sits in the comparator's rule, which cannot say which run was right, only that the pair is unstable, so the yield is a label on the pair and the unstable case is handed on as residue rather than resolved; the degradation is agreement for a shared reason, since two occupants who carry the same prior give the same verdict in either seat and the rule reads that as stability of the idea when it is symmetry of the prior, the two laboratories that replicate each other with the same reagent lot; the tell that separates the two is a swap that never flips on any claim, which measures the occupants' sameness and not the ideas' soundness; observed in the trial's design and in crossover trials, and the atlas's corpus holds no trial transcript, so the repo case is a rule and not yet a result; not denominator-manufactures' second net, which counts what the two nets missed, since here nothing is counted and the yield is a stability label on one verdict.
relations.to: Second family's difference: the same enumeration is run by two enumerators with different priors, and the composition yields the difference of their lists, which is a distinction about the members, that a member is reachable from one prior and not the other, rather than a bigger pile, as two field guides to the same coast whose birds each lacks, two dictionaries' headword lists, the atlas's refusal to accept two identical judge commands as a panel, since identical judges are one judge; the composition's shape is two passes over one question joined at a set difference; what crosses is the question and nothing else; the judgment sits in the reader of the difference, who must decide whether an item only one family reached is the family's artifact or the subject's member that the other family cannot see; the degradation is the vote, which keeps the intersection and discards the difference, so a majority over families returns the members every prior already held and throws away the only thing the composition made, and the second degradation is families that share a corpus, whose difference is empty for a reason the composition cannot see; the tell of a spent composition is a difference that shrinks as the families are made more capable, since capable families converge on the modal members; analytical, since the atlas's climb ledgers name the hand that made each breath and fifty-five of eighty-two lists were bred by more than one hand, so the difference set is computable and has not been computed; adds to denominator-manufactures' second net, which uses the two nets' overlap to estimate what both missed, the reading of the non-overlap as a member class; not Blind judge, which rates the passes, since here no one rates and the difference is the yield.
relations.label: If the two occupants exchanged by the swap are drawn from one family, a verdict stable under the swap is stable for the family's reason and the swap's label says nothing about the idea; the swap's yield exists only where the second family's difference is non-empty on claims of this kind, so the difference must be measured before the swap is trusted, and a swap that never flips on any claim is the measurement that the difference is empty.

relations.from: Cheap proposer, strong gate: a cheap pass proposes many candidates and a strong pass judges each against the list, so the composition yields volume the strong pass would not spend on and a recorded refusal for every drop, which is a labelled nonmember no single pass produces, as the atlas's climb whose cheap tier offers fifteen and whose strong-tier gate keeps or drops each with a reason written to the ledger, the patent examiner who can reject only the claims the applicant drafted, the acquisitions desk over the slush pile, the journal whose quality is bounded by what is submitted; the composition's shape is a proposer and a gate that can only subtract; what crosses is the candidates as text and the list to both sides; the judgment sits in the gate, but the frontier of the list sits in the proposer, since the gate cannot add, so a strong gate spends its taste sorting a cheap prior's rephrasings and the list's edge is the proposer's edge; the degradation is the plateau read as exhaustion, since a falling keep rate measures the proposer's frontier meeting the list and the flag cannot say whether the subject ran out or the proposer did, which enumeration-stalls holds; the second degradation is refusal without memory, since the gate is shown the list and never the ledger's residue, so a candidate refused last breath can be proposed and refused again as new; the tell of a spent proposer is a keep rate that tracks the proposer's tier and not the subject; observed; adds to enumeration-stalls' plateau the fact that the stall in this composition is the proposer's and the gate is the wrong seat to read it from.
relations.to: Gap named by one hand: one pass induces a typology over the list and names the cells that are empty or thin, a second pass fills the named cell, and nothing crosses between them but the cell's name, so the composition yields members in a region the flat pass would not reach and the yield's quality is set by what the name carries, as the atlas's climb, whose strong tier names up to three missing types and whose cheap tier is shown the list and the type name and asked for six members, and against it Mendeleev's eka-silicon, whose empty cell crossed to Winkler not as a name but as a predicted atomic weight, density, and oxide, so that the filler could recognize germanium when it was in the crucible; the composition's shape is a namer and a filler in series; what crosses is a name, or in the strong form a name with predicted properties; the judgment sits in the namer, since the filler answers the name, and the gate that judges the fill judges it against the list and not against the typology, which never crosses to the gate at all; the degradation is the cell's name plus a case, the item that reads as the type's label applied to the nearest example, which form-yields names as the manufactured item's tell; the tell here is a fill whose members all contain the type name; observed in the climb's design and in the periodic table; adds to form-yields' empty cell, which holds what the form makes visible, the fact that in a composition the cell's name is the only thing the filler sees, so the yield rises with what the namer was made to predict and not with the filler's tier.
relations.label: If the gate's keep rate falls with the list unchanged, the only crossing that can move the proposer's frontier is a name from the namer, since the gate can only subtract; a gap name with no predicted properties moves the proposer to the cell's label plus a case, and a gap name with predicted properties moves it to a member, so the composition's escape from its plateau is bounded by what the namer is made to predict, and a plateau flagged on keep rate alone cannot say whether the namer or the subject ran out.

relations.from: Trial with a burden: an advocate and an adversary build opposing cases under one scaffold and a judge reads the transcript under a burden set by the claim's class, so the composition yields grounds, the argument that decided it, which a judge reading the bare claim cannot name because without an opposing case nothing decided anything, as the atlas's trial whose judge must answer with a lean and one sentence naming the deciding argument, the moot court, the adversarial hearing whose finding of fact cites the cross-examination; the composition's shape is two opposed passes and a reader; what crosses is the opposing case to each side, and the whole transcript to the judge; the judgment sits in the judge, with the burden's threshold set by a hand that never saw the case, and an unproven claim is rejected rather than split; the degradation is the last word, since a balanced scaffold still has an order, and in the atlas's cross-examination the adversary answers last in every round, while the courtroom gives the last word to the side that carries the burden, so the two designs balance opposite asymmetries and neither is symmetric; the second degradation is eloquence, which the judge is told to disregard and which the transcript carries anyway; the tell is a verdict that moves when the order of the closing turns is reversed with the arguments held fixed; observed in the trial's design and the courtroom's, with no atlas transcript on record; not Swap and compare, which exchanges the occupants, since here the seats keep their occupants and the mechanism is the order of the seats.
relations.to: Combiner's arithmetic: several reads cross as numbers to a table whose rule decides what a disagreement becomes, and the composition yields either a verdict no reader gave or the disagreement as a member, according to the rule and not the reads, as the ensemble forecast whose mean track runs between two storm tracks through water no member predicted, the trimmed mean of the diving panel, the atlas's trial that returns contested on a sign split and refuses to average, its triangulation that reports the spread beside the mean; the composition's shape is a fan-in through arithmetic; what crosses is a number per read, since the reasons are stripped at the table; the judgment sits in the rule, which was written before any read was taken, so the map's most consequential seat is one that had no case in front of it; the degradation is averaging the shape away, a mean of plus and minus that reads as balance, and its mirror, a contested threshold so wide that every panel is contested and the composition never compresses; the tell of the first is a verdict at the middle of the scale that no read occupied, and of the second an owner list as long as the axis list; observed in ensemble forecasting and in the trial's rule; not Judges who cannot see each other, which holds the wall that makes the reads independent, since the table's rule does its work on reads however they were made.
relations.label: If the bench is more than one judge and the judges split in sign, the trial's rule returns contested and hands the claim to the residue, where a mean would have returned a lean near zero that reads as balance, so the trial's contested verdict is the combiner's yield and not any judge's; a bench of one has no combiner, and its verdict is the judge's alone with nothing to read a split from.

relations.from: Residue crossing to the fresh critic: the critic seat is denied the author's reasoning and given the record and the ledger, and the ledger carries the author's residue, the candidates the author rejected with why, so what was meant to be a fresh read of the fence arrives with the author's fence already drawn, and the composition yields, per map, a fact about the critic's boundary case, whether it is the author's residue re-read or a fence the author never tested, as the atlas's critique briefs that forbid the author's reasoning and require the ledger, and the eleven of thirty-eight critiques whose boundary case names one of the author's residue items, the reviewer sent the authors' response to an earlier round, the second radiologist handed the first's negative findings; the composition's shape is author then critic with a partial wall; what crosses is the artifact and, through the ledger, the author's rejections; the judgment sits in the critic on the items and in the author on the fence, whenever the fence crossed; the degradation is the re-read, a boundary case that is the author's tempting nonmember returned with the author's ruling, so the composition's independence was spent everywhere except where the practice's sharpening check wanted it; the tell is readable from the two files without reading either map, a residue handle inside the critique's boundary case; observed at eleven of thirty-eight by a string match on the residue handle, so the true rate is at least that; adds to fertile-forgettings' loss that creates a capacity the case where the loss was declared and did not occur, and to window-successions' ledger the fact that the ledger was built for the successor breath and is read by the critic as well.
relations.to: Judges who cannot see each other: each of two or more judges reads the same question on the same named axis without seeing the others' reads, and the composition yields the spread, which no single judge can produce because one read has no spread, and the spread localizes where the question underdetermines its answer, as the atlas's triangulation that refuses to run with one judge and names any axis where the reads split in sign as contested residue for an owner, the first round of a Delphi panel before the estimates are fed back, the two radiologists who read the film before conferring, the census count and the post-enumeration survey kept from each other's rosters; the composition's shape is parallel reads joined only at a table; what crosses is the axis wording, from whoever dimensionalized the question to every judge, and nothing between the judges; the judgment sits nowhere, since the composition's output on a contested axis is a name and an owner rather than a verdict, and only on an uncontested axis does it compress to a number; the degradation is consensus collapse, which arrives the moment a judge can see another's read, the Delphi second round that converges on the median, the jury room, the reviewer who reads the other reviews first, so that the spread narrows without the question changing; the tell is a spread that shrinks with the order in which the reads were taken; a second degradation is that the axes were one judge's, since the first judge dimensionalizes when no axes are given, so the panel disagrees only inside one judge's frame and an axis nobody named is contested by nobody; observed in the triangulation's design and in Delphi panels; not Combiner's arithmetic, which holds what the table does to the reads once they are in, since here the mechanism is the wall between the judges.
relations.label: If the author's residue crosses to the critic, the two are no longer judges who cannot see each other on the fence, and the critic's boundary case is a second read of the author's ruling; the wall holds on the items, which the residue does not describe, so the composition's independence is spent on the members and lost on the boundary; where the ledger's residue is withheld from the critic, the critic's fence is a second net and the difference between the two fences is the map's boundary claim tested.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does composing two or more passes yield a member, an ordering, or a distinction no single pass yields, what crosses between the passes, where does the judgment end up sitting, and how does each composition degrade?
exploration.changed_question: What does the thickness of what crosses do to where the judgment sits and to which degradation arrives, and can a crossing undo the composition it was meant to serve? Breath one placed the yield in the second pass and took the crossing to be the artifact; it sorted the compositions by seat. Pressing on Swap and compare, whose runs share nothing and whose yield sits in a comparator, and on Combiner's arithmetic, whose rule was written before any read, showed the yield can sit in the joining rule; pressing on the fresh-context critic showed that the ledger it is required to read carries the author's rejections, so a crossing meant to be thin was thick where it mattered, and the measure of that, eleven of thirty-eight boundary cases naming a residue handle, was computable from the corpus. The question turned from which pass yields to what crosses, and the walk re-sorted by the crossing, which put the degradations in order: on the thin half they are made of what did not cross, on the thick half of what did. Four members followed: a report of the seat's own distribution crossing as an instruction, the residue crossing to the critic, the record crossing whole to a checker that holds identity by string, and a second register crossing nothing but the subject.

gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing three items (the register rotation sharpened against its true neighbour the second-family diff, the seat-attractor item updated with this fleet's six-of-six modal verdicts, the cut-only hand corrected on its brief) and two edge labels (a cut does cascade; withholding the report also breaks the loop), with every atlas count and code claim recomputed and confirmed.

neighbors.left: Judges who cannot see each other: each of two or more judges reads the same question on the same named axis without seeing the others' reads, and the composition yields the spread, which no single judge can produce because one read has no spread, and the spread localizes where the question underdetermines its answer, as the atlas's triangulation that refuses to run with one judge and names any axis where the reads split in sign as contested residue for an owner, the first round of a Delphi panel before the estimates are fed back, the two radiologists who read the film before conferring, the census count and the post-enumeration survey kept from each other's rosters; the composition's shape is parallel reads joined only at a table; what crosses is the axis wording, from whoever dimensionalized the question to every judge, and nothing between the judges; the judgment sits nowhere, since the composition's output on a contested axis is a name and an owner rather than a verdict, and only on an uncontested axis does it compress to a number; the degradation is consensus collapse, which arrives the moment a judge can see another's read, the Delphi second round that converges on the median, the jury room, the reviewer who reads the other reviews first, so that the spread narrows without the question changing; the tell is a spread that shrinks with the order in which the reads were taken; a second degradation is that the axes were one judge's, since the first judge dimensionalizes when no axes are given, so the panel disagrees only inside one judge's frame and an axis nobody named is contested by nobody; observed in the triangulation's design and in Delphi panels; not Combiner's arithmetic, which holds what the table does to the reads once they are in, since here the mechanism is the wall between the judges.
neighbors.right: Combiner's arithmetic: several reads cross as numbers to a table whose rule decides what a disagreement becomes, and the composition yields either a verdict no reader gave or the disagreement as a member, according to the rule and not the reads, as the ensemble forecast whose mean track runs between two storm tracks through water no member predicted, the trimmed mean of the diving panel, the atlas's trial that returns contested on a sign split and refuses to average, its triangulation that reports the spread beside the mean; the composition's shape is a fan-in through arithmetic; what crosses is a number per read, since the reasons are stripped at the table; the judgment sits in the rule, which was written before any read was taken, so the map's most consequential seat is one that had no case in front of it; the degradation is averaging the shape away, a mean of plus and minus that reads as balance, and its mirror, a contested threshold so wide that every panel is contested and the composition never compresses; the tell of the first is a verdict at the middle of the scale that no read occupied, and of the second an owner list as long as the axis list; observed in ensemble forecasting and in the trial's rule; not Judges who cannot see each other, which holds the wall that makes the reads independent, since the table's rule does its work on reads however they were made.
neighbors.separating_case: Two panels are given the same two reads on one axis, plus eight tenths and minus eight tenths. In the first the judges see each other's reads before the table and the table reports the spread; the spread has collapsed to nothing before it is measured, and the table reports a settled axis. In the second the judges cannot see each other and the table takes the mean; the spread is real, reaches the table, and is thrown away as a lean of zero that reads as balance. Both compositions return the same word, for different reasons, and the tell is whether the reads in the transcript converged or only the verdict did: the first is the wall's failure and the second the rule's, and a designer who confuses them rebuilds the wall when the arithmetic was at fault, or rewrites the arithmetic when the judges were talking.

checks.boundary_case: The doctrine of splitting generator from critic is the tempting nonmember and is out: it names a shape and no yield, and every item on the map is a mechanism under it, not the doctrine. The second nonmember is the same pass run twice with the union taken, which is a bigger pile and not a member, an ordering, or a distinction; it is Second family's difference with the family the same, and by the edge from Swap and compare its difference is noise. The third is the summary that crosses, which is out to window-successions: how the summary was made and what it stripped belongs there; here the summary appears only as the thickness of a crossing, at Telling the seat its attractor, where a distribution condensed to a sentence is what crosses.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the walk conceals, Verdict menu to Telling the seat its attractor and back, in which a seat's distribution reported into the next brief becomes the next attractor, and the loop is broken by withholding the report, while the attractor itself is removed only by a menu whose verdicts cost the seat the same, so a better-informed seat is not the repair. It shows an incompatibility between the walk's two thinnest compositions: the swap's yield exists only where the second family's difference is non-empty, so the thin end's stability label is conditional on a measurement the thin end cannot make. It shows a dependency at the thick end, Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot to Cascade from the first pass, where the slot's leak is what the checker's cascade counts, and a silent fix turns the cascade into edges nobody argued. It shows a passage from Trial with a burden to Combiner's arithmetic, where a contested verdict is the rule's yield and not any judge's. And it shows the incompatibility that closes the walk, Residue crossing to the fresh critic against Judges who cannot see each other, where the ledger the critic must read undoes the wall on the fence and leaves it on the items. The inference the pile did not hold: every composition's yield is bounded by something on the other half of the walk, the thin end by a difference it cannot measure and the thick end by a valve that leaks, so no composition can certify its own yield from its own seat.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context: each item names a distinct composition, what crosses, where the judgment sits, and the degradation; the critic tried to break every atlas count and code claim and all held, found the closest pair (Second family's difference and Register rotation diff) collapsed into one shape with two knobs and repaired the register item to yield a survival profile over a roster with a re-ask control the family diff cannot have, and kept the strange members (a seat in a rule written before any case, a namer who cannot fail, a seat set by its menu and then by the report of its menu, a fresh critic handed the author's rejections) as mechanisms rather than advice.
